## Rotation Guidelines (for the planner)

- A primary emotion SHOULD NOT repeat across 3 consecutive chapters
- A hook type SHOULD NOT repeat across 3 consecutive chapters
- Every 5 chapters SHOULD include at least 1 quieter chapter
- 3 consecutive chapters SHOULD NOT share the same setting / time / weather
